title: IELTS Vocabulary Practice - IELTS Vocabulary - Academic Verbs
subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: The new policy aims to ______ the gap between the rich and the poor.
questions.explain: 'Bridge the gap' is a common idiom/collocation meaning to connect two things or reduce the difference between them.
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: We need to ______ a detailed analysis of the data before publishing the results.
questions.explain: 'Carry out' is a phrasal verb often used with research, experiments, or analysis, meaning to perform or conduct.
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: The committee will **scrutinize** the proposal before making a decision.
questions.explain: To 'scrutinize' means to examine or inspect closely and thoroughly.
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary

questions.q: We need to **mitigate** the risks associated with this investment.
questions.explain: 'Mitigate' means make less severe, serious, or painful (alleviate/reduce).
questions.subject: IELTS Vocabulary
